records.name: Sid Barricade
records.biography_en: Sid reroutes foot traffic whenever a HyperNorm scene acquires an inconvenient view.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He pointed me toward the authorized exit. It was behind the authorized entrance.

records.name: Iris Tackspark
records.biography_en: Iris welds up loose seams in the HyperNorm perimeter. She leaves the bad ones visible until someone initials them.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Her weld held. The initials cracked immediately.

records.name: Cal Valvegrip
records.biography_en: Cal services the pipes that feed reassurance into the HyperNorm estate. He has yet to find the return line.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I reported a drip. He asked whether I meant the pipe or the committee.

records.name: Bert Bluecoat
records.biography_en: Bert repaints the parts of town the Men in Black prefer to describe as undisturbed.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The first coat covered the damage. The second covered the date.

records.name: Mira Leadloop
records.biography_en: Mira found the emergency sign wired to the circuit it was supposed to warn about. She left a note with a very neat diagram.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The sign came back on before anyone read the note.

records.name: Pip Ridgehook
records.biography_en: Pip tiles the HyperNorm façades that appear overnight after a cleanup. He secures the lowest roof tile first.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He told me the view was fine. He hadn't looked at it.
